## Automated AI review

> **Community review:** Independent automated community review, unaffiliated with the Omarchy team, intended to help prepare PRs for their review.

**Verified (source inspection):** for a 7-day window with more than 6 hours left, the meter shows six dividers at 1/7 to 6/7 of the track, which splits it into 24-hour slices counted from the window start. Qt Quick stacks `Repeater` delegates at the Repeater's position, so the dividers draw above both the track and the fill. The 5-hour session meter, model-scoped session meters and the balance meter keep no dividers. `Panel.qml` is unchanged on the current `quattro` tip, so the change applies as written.

### "Weekly" is decided by time until reset, not by the window

[`Panel.qml:751`](https://github.com/omacom/omarchy/blob/1db180011198154b9f5d1c7efdea1028388ab5f0/shell/plugins/agents/Panel.qml#L751) sets `weekly: root.resetMsFor(limitRow.window) > 6 * 3600000`. `resetMsFor` returns `-1` when the reset time is empty or unparseable. The result therefore depends on the clock and on whether a reset time exists:

```text
Window                                   time to reset    dividers   intended
Weekly / "Fable Weekly", 6 h to 7 d      > 6 h            6          6
Weekly, final 6 h of the week            0 to 6 h         none       6
Weekly, no resetsAt from the collector   -1               none       6
Session (5-hour)                         <= 5 h           none       none
Monthly or other long window (if sent)   > 6 h            6          none
```

- The last-6-hours case happens every week. On an open panel, the dividers disappear within 30 seconds of the countdown passing 6 hours.
- Both collectors allow a missing reset time. `omarchy-agent-usage-claude` keeps windows with an empty reset time on purpose, and the Codex protocol types `resetsAt` as nullable, which the Codex collector turns into `""`. How often real accounts send this was not measured.
- The monthly row is conditional. The panel and the Claude collector already title "Monthly" windows, but no current provider payload was confirmed to contain one.

**Impact:** the pace guide disappears for the last quarter of the final day and never appears for a weekly window without a reset time. A longer window would be cut into sevenths that do not stand for days. Percentages and countdowns are unaffected.

**Suggested change:** classify by window identity. Model-scoped titles are built as `name + " " + "Weekly"` ([`bin/omarchy-agent-usage-claude:701`](https://github.com/omacom/omarchy/blob/1db180011198154b9f5d1c7efdea1028388ab5f0/bin/omarchy-agent-usage-claude#L701)), and flat weekly windows reach the panel titled "Weekly" through `windowTitle`. Either of these covers every current producer without depending on the clock:

- a case-insensitive check for a trailing "Weekly" in `window.title`;
- carrying `windowSpanMs(label)` through `limitWindow` and testing for 7 days. This changes the `assertDeepEqual` expectations in `test/shell.d/agent-usage-claude-limits-test.sh`.

The PR description says the model-scoped titles "don't say 'weekly'". The collector code above shows they do.

**Theme note:** the dividers are painted in the popup background colour, so they read as cuts only while `popups.background-alpha` is 1.0, which every in-tree theme uses. A custom theme with a translucent popup background would show a blend instead, and at alpha 0 the dividers would be invisible. This follows from source and was not rendered.

**Optional test improvement:** `test/shell.d/agents-panel-test.sh` only checks the bar button's mouse bindings, so it passes with or without this change. A small assertion on the weekly classification, in the style of the existing helper-evaluation test, would cover the new behaviour.

---

**Test scope:** source inspection at head `1db18001`, including the Claude and Codex usage collectors and public Qt 6 `qtdeclarative` source for `Repeater` stacking and date parsing. No tests were run and nothing was rendered, so divider appearance, contrast and fractional-scaling behaviour are unverified. Real provider payloads were not queried.

**AI process:** Opus 5.5 Medium coordination and synthesis, independent Opus 5.5 Xhigh and GPT 6 Sol Xhigh technical assessments, Opus 5.5 Medium editorial check.
